description.narrative: El objetivo general del Programa de obras mltiples es mejorar el transporte terrestre de cargas y pasajeros en la Red Vial Estadual. Esta mejora se alcanzar rehabilitando tramos crticos de la red, pavimentando otros tramos, disminuyendo los costos de transporte y aumentando la seguridad vial. Asimismo, se buscar promover la sustentabilidad del sistema vial mediante mejoras en la eficiencia de la gestin vial. La operacin mejorar la accesibilidad a mercados y servicios bsicos coadyuvando al desarrollo de las actividades econmicas en su rea de influencia y contribuyendo al aumento de la competitividad de la regin.

The Program's general objective is to improve mobility, safety and accessibility for passengers and goods in the State Road Network (SRN). This improvement will be achieved by rehabilitating critical sections of the network, paving another sections and reducing transportation costs and increasing road safety. The Program will promote the sustainability of the SRN by improving the efficiency of the road management system. The operation will improve travel time and accessibility to markets and services boosting economic activities in its area of influence and contributing to the region's competitiveness.
